# DOT Hazmat Carrier Training: Highway, Air/IATA, Rail & Vessel

> DOT Hazmat Carrier Training: 4 self-paced online courses from $49.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [DOT Hazmat Carrier Requirements: Air/IATA](https://dot-hazmat-carrier.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-160): $49.99 per person, 3 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with the DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Part 172 Subpart H. Enroll: https://dot-hazmat-carrier.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=160.
